01.description: Clavicus Vile is one of the Daedric Princes. He is known for granting wishes, often in ways that turn out poorly for the recipient.
01.name: Clavicus Vile

13.description: Meridia, once known as Merid-Nunda, is a Daedric Prince associated with the energy of living beings. Unlike many Daedric Princes, she is not universally regarded as evil.
13.name: Meridia

02.description: Sheogorath is the Daedric Prince of Madness. His realm in Oblivion, the Shivering Isles, is divided into Mania, whose inhabitants embrace luxury, art, and revelry, and the darker, horror-filled Dementia.
02.name: Sheogorath

16.description: Sanguine is the Daedric Prince of debauchery and excess. His sphere includes lust, sloth, gluttony, and greed. He delights in tempting mortals into vice and is often depicted holding a bottle of wine or beer.
16.name: Sanguine

05.description: Hermaeus Mora, also called Herma-Mora, is the Daedric Prince of knowledge and memory. He is also associated with fate and the past and future.
05.name: Hermaeus Mora

21.description: Azura's sphere is dawn and dusk, and she is associated with twilight. Her titles include Queen of the Evening Sky and Mother of the Rose. She is often considered benevolent, but can also be fierce and ruthless.
21.name: Azura

09.description: Peryite is a Daedric Prince whose sphere includes the natural order, disease, and pestilence.
09.name: Peryite

09.description: Namira is a Daedric Prince associated with ancient darkness and decay. She is also called the Lady of Decay and the Goddess of Darkness, and is associated with spiders, insects, slugs, and other creatures that inspire disgust.
09.name: Namira

05.description: Hircine is the Daedric Prince of the hunt. His sphere includes hunting, stalking prey, and the pursuit of the greatest game.
05.name: Hircine

10.description: Vaermina, also known as the Dreamweaver, is a Daedric Prince associated with dreams, nightmares, and ominous visions. She is also known for stealing memories.
10.name: Vaermina

08.description: Nocturnal is a Daedric Prince associated with night and darkness. Her titles include the Lady Luck, Mistress of Shadows, and Ur-dra.
08.name: Nocturnal

08.description: Malacath is a Daedric Prince and protector of the scorned and rejected. He is associated with oaths and blood curses and is a patron of the Orsimer.
08.name: Malacath

13.description: Mephala, a Daedric Prince, is known as the Spinner, the Webspinner, and the Spider. Her sphere includes lies, sex, murder, secrets, and conspiracies; she also meddles in mortal affairs.
13.name: Mephala

02.description: Boethiah is a Daedric Prince associated with deception, conspiracy, murder, treason, and the overthrow of power.
02.name: Boethiah

20.description: Mehrunes Dagon is the Daedric Prince of destruction, change, revolution, energy, and ambition. He is associated with disasters such as fire, earthquakes, and floods.
20.name: Mehrunes Dagon

20.description: Molag Bal is the Daedric Prince of domination and enslavement, also known as the Prince of Intrigue and the Reaper of Souls. He seeks to claim mortal souls, subjugate them, and sow discord. He is associated with the origin of vampirism.
20.name: Molag Bal
